KYUNG HEE UNIVERSITY INFORMATION SHEET 2026-2027 
 
University Name KYUNG HEE UNIVERSITY 
Address 
[Seoul Campus] 
26 Kyungheedae-ro, Dongdaemun-gu, Seoul 02447, Korea 
[Global Campus] 
1732 Deogyeong-daero, Giheung-gu, Yongin-si, Gyeonggi-do 17104, Korea 
Online Platforms  
Official Website: http://oia.khu.ac.kr 
Information Page: https://kyungheeoia.notion.site/studyatkhu 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/khu_international/# 
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@KHUINTERNATIONAL 
Telephone [Seoul] 82-2-961-0030 / [Global] 82-31-201-3965 
Contact Per son Kevin Kim, Associate Director / inbound.mobility@khu.ac.kr 
Procedures for the Exchange 
Programme 
Email Nomination → Online Application and Document Submission 
(Link will be provided to the students) → Acceptance Notice  
Nomination Deadlines  Spring Term: October 30th 
Fall Term: April 30th 
Application Deadlines  Spring Term: November 30th  
Fall Term: May 30th  
Academic Term Dates  Spring Term: March to June 
Fall Term: September to December 
Exchange Period  1 Semester to 1 Academic Year(2 Semesters) 
Level of Study  
Undergraduate level ONLY 
- Graduate (Master’s) students may also join the exchange program; 
however, they are limited to taking undergraduate-level courses only. 
- Students in their last term are discouraged to participate in the programme. 
Exchange Program Track & 
Language Requirements 
1) Korean track(Proficiency document submission required) 
- TOPIK Level 5 or higher    OR 
- Korean major students: Students with a letter of language proficiency 
from the Dean of Korean Language Department(Sophomore or higher) 
  
2) English track(Proficiency document submission NOT required) 
- TOEFL IBT 82  / IELTS 6.5 or higher recommended 
 
Minimum GPA Requirement  2.5 out of 4.0 or above 
Recommended Credit Load  3~5(9~15 credits) courses per term 
Minimum-Maximum Workload  3~6(9~18 credits) courses per term 
Undergraduate Grading Scale  4.3

2 
 
Course Information / Syllabus  
http://sugang.khu.ac.kr  
* Change language setting to ‘English’ and go to ‘Course Schedule Index’ 
* ‘Bilingual’ courses are mainly taught in Korean with English materials

the semester starts. 
*Students are responsible for checking the availability of English-taught 
courses and their prerequisites in advance. The availability of English-taught 
courses may vary across departments.

Application Requirements  
* Students of Non-OECD 
nationality must submit a hard 
copy of their Certificate of 
Enrolment(with Apostille or 
Consular Authentication) and 
Official Bank Statement 
according to Korea’s 
immigration regulations 
 
 
*Students must be officially nominated by their home institution 
via email before they can submit their application. Specific details 
on each document will be provided to students at a later date. 
 
(1) Submission via KHU Online Platform  
Deadline : (Spring Term) November 30 (Fall Term) May 30 
1) Full-size colour Copy of Passport(including the signature page) 
2) Scanned ID Photo (3.5x4.5, coloured, shot in white background) 
3) Certificate of Enrolment(English) 
4) Official Academic Transcript(English) 
5) Letter of Recommendation(English or Korean) 
6) (KHU Form) Study Plan(Korean or English) 
7) (KHU Form) Medical Assessment 
8) (KHU Form) GPA Conversion&Academic Capability Confirmation (if needed) 
9) Korean Language Proficiency Document (Korean Track Only) 
 
(2) Submission via Google Form (Specific deadlines TBA) 
1) Official Bank Statement 
- The account balance should be at least USD 5,000 for a semester and 
USD 9,000 or more for a year. Required issuance date will be notified 
later.(Parents’ account accepted with a proof of family relations 
document) 
2) Insurance Certificate(English)

3 
 
Arrival & Orienta tion Dates  
- Students are expected to arrive in Korea between mid and late 
February(Spring Semester)/August(Fall Semester) 
- Orientation will be held at the end of February/August and all 
participating students MUST attend 
- Specific dates for orientation: TBA 
Dormitory Fee  
(in local currency)  
*Price is subject to change  
 
[Seoul Campus Sewha Hall] 
- https://sewhahall.khu.ac.kr/ 
- Double room only, KRW1,290,000 / Term  *Meal plan not included 
- Curfew 1AM, Monthly Room Checks 
 
[Global Campus Woojungwon] 
- https://wjwdorm.khu.ac.kr/ 
- Double room only, KRW1,240,000 / Term  *Meal plan not included 
 
*Spots are NOT guaranteed due to limited availability 
*Application details will be announced via email to nominated students  
*Application period : (Fall semester) mid-June  
(Spring semester) mid-December 
* Required : Valid Tuberculosis(TB) Test Result / Measles Immunity Test Result 
- Required Test date TBA (Do not take the test in advance before announcement) 
Insurance 
*Price is subject to change 
 
Students must obtain an overseas insurance BEFORE entering Korea. 
After arrival in Korea, students are AUTOMATICALLY subscribed to 
the National Health Insurance (Monthly fee: approx. KRW80,000). 
Private insurance is still required throughout the stay as additional 
safeguard against any unexpected situations such as emergency 
repatriation. 
 
Visa Requirements  
 
Students MUST obtain D-2-6(Exchange Student Visa) BEFORE 
they enter Korea. 
Campus Facilities  
Dormitory, Library, Cafeteria, Performance Hall, Medical Centre an d 
University Hospital, etc. 
The campuses are approximately 1.5 to 2 hours apart by car. 
- University shuttle buses run between the campuses during the weekdays. 
Distance between each campus 
(Seoul & Global Campus) 
The campuses are approximately 1.5 to 2 hours apart by car. 
- University shuttle buses run between the campuses during the weekdays. 
Distance from Airport  Approximately 1 to 1.5 hours by car from Incheon International 
Airport(ICN) to both campuses. 
Additional Information for the 
Nomination 
- Please check the enclosed nomination template and provide the 
required information for the Email Nomination.  
- Please note that there will be restrictions on the number of students 
we can accept due to the limited resources we can offer to exchange 
students and other possible constraints. 
 
 The information is subject to change under the circumstances
